claim.name: hover-liquid-distort
claim.label: Ripple Amplitude
claim.description: The surface goes liquid under the cursor — slow viscous ripples well out from the touch point and settle like honey when the pointer leaves.

claim.name: pointer-glitch-split
claim.label: Bands
claim.description: The cursor slices the surface into glitch bands — RGB-split slivers shearing out of alignment around the pointer, snapping clean when it leaves.

claim.name: pixel-sort-sweep
claim.label: Sweep Speed
claim.description: A sorting wave sweeps the surface — content smearing into directional streaks along the wavefront, resolving crisp behind it — the glitch-art pixel-sort look, tamed.

claim.name: hover-displacement-map
claim.label: Relief Depth
claim.description: Hover pours a hidden relief into the surface — a procedural displacement map embossing the content, deepening as the cursor nears.

claim.name: click-shockwave
claim.label: Ring Speed
claim.description: Engage and a shockwave detonates from the center — one crisp pressure ring racing outward, kicking the surface and its chrome as it passes.

claim.name: crt-warp
claim.label: Barrel Curve
claim.description: The surface becomes an old CRT — barrel-curved glass, drifting scanlines, and a slow rolling flicker band — retro phosphor warmth over the real content.
